gloss: cannot do anything about; by no means; at all

definitions.gloss: cannot do anything about; unable to handle; hopeless
definitions.explanation: indicates that something is beyond one's ability to control or manage, often used with negative expressions

examples.english: There's nothing I can do about it.

examples.japanese: {眠|ねむ}くてどうにも{我慢|がまん}できない。
examples.english: I'm so sleepy I simply can't stand it.

examples.japanese: この{状況|じょうきょう}はどうにも{手|て}の{打|う}ちようがない。
examples.english: There's simply no way to deal with this situation.

notes:
USAGE:
Typically used with negative expressions:
- どうにもならない - can't do anything about it
- どうにも～ない - simply cannot ~
- どうにも{手|て}がつけられない - can't handle it at all

NUANCE:
Expresses helplessness or frustration at an uncontrollable situation. Stronger than simply saying できない.

CONTRAST WITH どうにか:
- どうにか - positive outcome (somehow succeeded)
- どうにも - negative outcome (can't do anything about it)

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- {如何|いかん}ともしがたい - beyond one's power (formal)
- どうしようもない - hopeless, can't be helped
- {手|て}の{施|ほどこ}しようがない - nothing can be done
